crop_context: Grass turf/lawn with ground-level top-down UGV imagery; not validated for Indian crops
artifact_export_license_metadata: AGPL-3.0 appears in the embedded Ultralytics export metadata; the release card states that the model weights are CC-BY-4.0. Review this distinction before redistributing the artifact.
preprocessing: RGB letterbox to 640x640, float32 values in [0, 1]
inference_notes: Images larger than the model input use a full-frame pass plus up to six overlapping tiles (3x2 landscape, 2x3 portrait, approximately 12% overlap). Boxes are mapped to the original image and deduplicated with class-aware NMS. Same-class tile fragments with at least 80% parent coverage are suppressed; a 65% fallback requires the tile box and parent to continue across the same tile edge. Invalid or below-threshold parents cannot suppress a tile. Smaller images use one pass. Reports no species identity.

reported_metrics.source: release card; not independently reproduced by Botanika

limitations: Single broadleaf-vs-grass class, not species classification. Core data is Rumex obtusifolius in turf plus other public weed sets. It has no Botanika validation on Indian crops or camera geometry; treat detections as an experimental visual cue and collect local acceptance evidence before relying on it.
